comments.author: Universalicious
comments.body:
Ugh So MUCH Bad Info about the University going around in the game. It is really very simple.

Submissions needed to unlock buildings
(check your event progress - YOU MUST be in london for event continuation to unlock these - the event line moves in 3 submissions 5 submissions then 10 submissions)

Basic Research Building - Submissions 0
Advanced Research Building - Submissions 12
Specialty Research Building - Submissions 30
Free Research Building - Submissions 50

Initially accessing these building was restricted to University Development which was a server effort. As it stands now it is at level 4.

Which tasks appear in their respective Bldg's is based on the amount of submissions you have made, see this site for the amount needed.

Event is completed after 100 submissions (assuming you were in london for every event continuation - doing 20 submissions between event follow up will NOT put you up that many submissions worth of the event time line)

comments.author: Universalicious
comments.body:
Best way to unlock access to all buildings and techs (access not use)

Needed Skills
Cooking r1 Storage r2

Needed Books
Traveller's food procuring skill
Livestock secrets - Poultry

Other Items
Eggs, ducks or chickens.
Lots and Lots of Vigor food - or use tavern.

Method
Select Basic Research Building - Basic Prod Tech 1.
Turn eggs into chickens or chickens into eggs.
Continue the above till Advanced Research Building opens.

Select Advanced Research Building - Basic Prod Tech 1.
Turn more eggs into chickens and chicken back into eggs.
This is a limitless source of goods to produce.

Reasoning
When you reach 100 submissions - or finish the event line. you NO longer need to go back and forth from where you were doing the other university skills to London to continue the event. Now you will have all techs available to you from any archive and something nice that you will receive at the end of the event. Yes the same research is repeatable, you wont make a huge amount of credits doing it this way, but you will open the other researches that do give nice credits.

Time taken
From Submissions 0 - 100 (5hrs 38mins)

Sidenote

Now anybody reading this now knows why we were all standing there at the professor and not having to run around like headless chickens doing research :) - No Chicken Pun Intended :D

comments.author: Kicker
comments.body:
@Universalicious

Your guide is wonderful, but other people are allowed to post information, and especially to correct misinformation. Your guide focused on grinding submissions; when people posted their preferred method to grind CREDITS, you seemed to take this as a comment on your guide.

While it may be true that the vast majority of people don't have Alchemy/Linguistics, information that is correct and relevant is welcome here.

Doowah/Lewis/Raythe are correct, ANY great success (not just alchemy/ling recipes) will complete the Special Production tech 1 in the advanced school, and it is very fast source for credits and submissions...if you have alch. or ling. of course.

To add my own info, Shipwreck History in the advanced school is another great easy one for credits (10 long voyages = 800 credits) for those with r2 salvage or haul. Land Battle Tech 2 in the Specialty school is also good for credits if you are dungeon-running (9-10 dungeon runs = 1400 credits). Finding a thesis to do while you are doing what you want to do is the key to earning credits while not getting burned out grinding.

comments.author: Raythe
comments.body:
This will be my last post on this issue because it's turning from sharing info into more of a see-who-can-pee-higher-up-on-the-wall.

Advanced college, special production is probably the most effective means of grinding CREDITS. It requires r2 alchemy or linguistics to even be able to see it. You get 5 points towards your thesis for using an alchemy or linguistics recipe, but here's the kicker: you get 15 points towards your thesis for a great success. This is ANY great success with any production attempt. These go by blisteringly fast because after 7 great successes you are done, 100 credits and 50 trade fame. If you are just interested in finishing the college event then this isn't the one for you. If you need to grind trade fame or fame in general it's a valid option. If you need credits to switch around your special skills I don't believe there is a faster way to get it done.
